title: Trusted by businesses across Pakistan
case_title: From scattered paperwork to fully registered in under three weeks
case_text: A new Islamabad-based startup came to us with no company structure and no tax registration. We handled SECP incorporation, FBR registration and a compliance calendar so the founders could focus on clients instead of paperwork. Within three weeks, they were fully registered and knew exactly what to file and when.

items.name: Ahmed Raza
items.quote: KHR took our messy books and FBR backlog and sorted everything within weeks. Genuinely responsive — they pick up the phone.

items.name: Sana Khan
items.quote: They registered our company and handled the trademark without us chasing a single deadline. Clear pricing from day one.
